reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.63% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change -12bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 150 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 87 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 14.4 sits at the 3th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.4, so implied carries +4.0 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nvidia pauses 'AI Compute Partnership' revenue-share financing deals with smaller AI cloud providers over antitrust concerns
items.note: Nvidia pulled a two-month-old program that backstopped smaller neoclouds' GPU utilization for a revenue cut, pulling back a vendor-financing support mechanism just as smaller AI infrastructure buildouts lean hardest on it.

items.headline: IREN posts $639M FY26 impairment charge and debt load surges to $7.6B as it pivots from bitcoin mining to AI cloud
items.note: Non-cash impairments from decommissioning bitcoin-mining hardware plus a jump in total debt to fund GPU buildout illustrate the balance-sheet strain smaller neoclouds are taking on to chase AI compute demand, even though cash and committed GPU financing remain large.

items.headline: SoftBank weighs $10-20B bond sale as existing notes sell off, racing to refinance $40B OpenAI bridge loan
items.note: SoftBank's existing 8.5% 2036 notes fell ~2.5c on reports it may sell up to $20B in new dollar/euro bonds (its first 144A deal in a decade) to refinance the $40B bridge loan backing its OpenAI stake — continued forced-refinancing stress in the AI shadow-financing chain.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
